syllabus: Unit 8 has 〜より〜のほうが, 〜と〜とどちら, 〜の中で〜がいちばん, どちらも／どれも, 〜くなる, 〜になる, 〜くする, 〜にする, 〜だけ and 〜しか〜ない: a fair N5 set in a sensible order, given that どれ and どれも for two things are heard casually but marked wrong here?

n5u08d1.c1: Answer どちら. どれ for two things is heard casually; clearly wrong? Also the どれ example (どれがあなたの本ですか) does not show three things. Fine?
n5u08d1.d3: Answer どちら (two drinks). Please confirm どれ is clearly wrong here.
n5u08d1.d4: Answer どちらも. どれも is wrong only because two animals are named, and it is taught on day 2. Fair?
n5u08d1.k: Two-trains scene: 三十分 is read さんじゅっぷん. Fine?
n5u08d1.r1: じてんしゃ is never mentioned. Is この店の前から出ますよ natural for a bus?
n5u08d2.p2: The page says だれも is almost always negative; the watch marks だれも来ます wrong (use みんな). Accurate?
n5u08d2.d3: Answer どちらも (二つのかさ). どれも is heard casually for two. Clearly wrong?
n5u08d2.d5: Star item. いちばん安い is one tile. Fine?
n5u08d2.e3: Star item (この三つの中でどれがいちばん新しい本ですか). Easy, and a bit clunky. Natural?
n5u08d2.k: Ranking scene uses 人気 (N4?), also in k1 and e1. Day 2 also uses せが高い, かさ, パーティー, あき, なつ. Fair for N5?
n5u08d3.c1: Answer になりました. でした is ruled out only by 今は. Clearly wrong?
n5u08d3.d2: Many wrong options in this unit are made-up forms that are not words (よに, いいに, きれいく, をだけ, ひとにん, 女く, 小い). Acceptable as distractors?
n5u08d3.d3: Answer に. 大学生が is wrong because the subject is わたし. Clearly wrong?
n5u08d3.e3: Star item (十時になりましたから、ねましょうか). Too easy?
n5u08d3.k: Shop-notice scene includes 駅前 (えきまえ) as one word. Fair for N5?
n5u08d3.r1: Quick response. がんばってください may be too easy. Is まいにちれんしゅうしましたから natural?
n5u08d4.d1: Answer 小さくして. 小さくなってください fails only on meaning. Clearly wrong?
n5u08d4.d5: Star item, close to the teach page example (ラジオのおとを小さくしてください). Too close?
n5u08d4.e3: Star item. The tiles split オレンジ and ジュース, which gives the order away. Fine?
n5u08d4.k: Lunch-menu scene. Day 4 also uses 白ワイン, だいどころ, こうちゃ, すずしい, コップ. All fair N5 words?
n5u08d4.k1: Answer のみもの. たべもの and よみもの are real words; のみの is not a word. Fine as wrong readings?
n5u08d4.r1: The passage says わたしも魚がすきですが、きのうのばんも魚を食べましたから、カレーにしました. Natural?
n5u08d5.c1: Answer しか. だけ before ありません (here, d3 and e1) is wrong only through the sentence's meaning. Clearly wrong?
n5u08d5.d5: Star item (電車まで五分しかありませんから). Is 電車まで natural as a short way of saying it?
n5u08d5.d6: Same shape as star d5 (〜しか／だけ…から、…). Too similar?
n5u08d5.e3: Star item. ありません and でした are separate tiles. Fine?
n5u08d5.k: Ticket-office scene: 一人 is split ひと + り. Day 5 also uses ねむい, けさ, えいがかん, きっぷうりば, いそがしい, ぼくたち. Fair?
n5u08d5.r1: In the talk, ケーキはだめですね may sound abrupt. Natural?
n5u08d6.c1: Close to the day 4 comparison (へやをあかるくしました). Too similar?
n5u08d6.d1: Answer どちら (うどんとそば). いちばん and どちらも are easy; is どれ clearly wrong for two?
n5u08d6.d5: Star item (前より百円しか安くなりませんでした). Natural? 前より stays outside the tiles. Fine?
n5u08d6.e1: Answer いちばん. だけ gives がだけ, an easy wrong option. Fine?
n5u08d6.e3: Star item. The ★ on ほうが is easy. Fine?
n5u08d6.k: Book-sale scene uses 外国語 and reuses 来週, 円, 安. Day 6 also uses できる (new shops) and かみをみじかくしました. Fair?
n5u08d6.r1: The notice writes こうちゃ　三百円（かわりません）. Clear enough?
n5u08t.6: Answer すき. Does きらいでしたが rule out じょうず and へた clearly enough?
n5u08t.7: Answer 二つだけあります. Is 二つもあります clearly wrong?
n5u08t.8: Answer へやをそうじしました. Close enough to へやをきれいにしました?
n5u08t.12: Answer どちらも. どれも for two cameras is wrong only by the N5 rule. Fair for a test?
n5u08t.14: Uses ズボン and みじかい; the test also has たのむ, となり, パンや. All N5 words?
n5u08t.15: Answer だけ. 日よう日だけ seems odd when Saturday is also free. Fine?
